# Vendored code

`onit_command_policy.py` is `src/mcp/servers/tasks/os/bash/command_policy.py` from OnIt (https://github.com/sibyl-oracles/onit), Apache-2.0, copied unchanged at commit 75ff8dc. Its licence header stays in the file. Do not edit it: change `servers/shell_guard.py` instead, so a newer copy can replace this one.
